title: Refractive index value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the correct numerical or symbolic expression for the refractive index, n = 2√3/3 or approximately 1.155.

title: Total internal reflection condition
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply Snell's law for total internal reflection, relating the critical angle C to the refractive index via n = 1/sin C.

title: Geometric angle analysis
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning must correctly identify the geometric relationships (e.g., triangle angles) to determine the critical angle C = 30° from the quarter-circle arc geometry.

title: Propagation time expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the propagation time must be correctly given as t = (2√3 R)/c or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Path length calculation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly calculate the total optical path length inside the brick, s = 3R, using geometry (e.g., sum of segments).

title: Speed in medium
description: Important Criteria: The speed of light in the material must be derived from the refractive index using v = c/n.

title: Incorrect critical angle
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the critical angle is incorrectly identified from the geometry (e.g., not 30°), leading to a wrong refractive index.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the final time answer has incorrect units, missing the factor of R/c, or a sign error in the geometric construction.
